column11: solved to an anchor, with the multiple on it a judgement. The anchor is Qulipta's own reach in adults: $1,036mm of FY2025 revenue over the book's 31,236,457 adult migraine pool is $33.17 per adult migraineur, which on the 1,640,404 adolescent pool is a peak of $54.4mm. The multiple is 1.0. The competitive case: AJOVY (fremanezumab) is already labelled for 'the preventive treatment of episodic migraine in pediatric patients who are 6 to 17 years of age and who weigh 45 kg or more' (openFDA label set id 98e344ea-5916-4947-b6f2-4a76ccc04b6b, effective 2026-06-05), so atogepant would be the second CGRP agent in this population, not the first; topiramate is labelled for prevention from 12, and propranolol and amitriptyline are used off label, all generic. For it: a daily tablet against a monthly injection, and Ajovy's 45 kg floor leaves lighter children with no labelled CGRP option. Adults face as crowded a field (four CGRP antibodies and rimegepant), so the adult reach is carried over unscaled
